tests.name: session end yields a cited retrospective AND a handoff, each keeping user, assistant and tool statements distinct, with no forced context
an abandoned session produces a partial handoff that says it is incomplete and invents no outcome
explicit decisions, findings, notes and task completion go through the same registration, redaction and queue, with correct speaker evidence
uncited or mis-sourced retrospectives are rejected and nothing is promoted to shared knowledge
a new source becomes a cited, reviewable page with dependency edges; the original bytes never change
incremental compile: a related source updates only the affected page as a new revision; unrelated pages and the rest of the wiki are untouched
dependency edges find affected pages without keyword overlap, and a source on a new topic creates a new page
citation lint and target validation: uncited claims, bad citation numbers, unsupplied or source-less targets never become knowledge
privacy and consistency: private sources are never compiled into the global wiki, a page that changed since compilation is not overwritten, repeated events are idempotent
one bounded repair attempt: a model that fixes its citations is accepted, one that does not is still rejected, and there is never a loop
real model: incremental wiki compilation obeys the safety gates (and we record whether it also complied with the citation rules)

gaps.reason: Enable with MDB_REAL_MODEL_TEST=1 (default provider claude-cli). Passed once during M3 (see verification/wiki/m3.md); it spends a little model quota. Model quality (groundedness, hallucination rate) is not scored.

gaps.item: Claim extraction as a separate stage and lint of claim-to-span support
gaps.reason: Compilation is one model call per source (plus one repair attempt). The deterministic checks are: evidence is real and readable, target page was supplied, at least one source is cited, every statement cites [n] or says (inference), the page has not changed since compilation. Whether a cited span really supports the sentence is not machine-checked.

gaps.item: Page merge/split and topic pages beyond create/update
gaps.reason: A source updates at most one supplied page or creates one page.

gaps.item: Re-processing when a source is replaced by a new import of the same file
gaps.reason: Imported sources are immutable; a re-import is a new source object and is compiled like any new source. No explicit "supersedes" link between the two imports exists.
No supported host emits a task-complete hook. task.completed arrives only through explicit `mdb memory record`.

limitations: Retrospectives and handoffs are model output checked for citations, not for factual correctness.
Affected pages are chosen by dependency edges and keyword overlap, not semantic similarity.
